text:
maria: FYI I opened a PR that changes the KV-cache eviction + quantized serving defaults. It's blocked on architecture/RFC review before we merge into canary. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/pull/4321

aj: pinging arch squad — can someone eyeball? we need an RFC link in the PR and a quick SLO delta estimate. @leo @sre-oncall

maria: RFC is live: https://r.internal/rfcs/2026-quant-kv-cache — tldr: segment-based eviction to reduce KV misses for long-context 2-stage batching. Behavioral change mostly under long contexts, small code change but runtime path differs. I added the link to the PR description now.

leo: quick Q: do you have perf numbers for 8k vs 32k sequences? also curious about p50/p95 shift for dedicated vs hosted.

maria: local benches attached in PR comments, pasted quick snippet: ```bench run --model t5-8b --seq 8192 --batch 4 -> throughput 1100 tok/s -> 1230 tok/s; p50 18ms -> 23ms``` 32k shows larger throughput gains. p95 impact small in synthetic.

olivia: design note — will this change cache determinism for repeated prefixes? we should surface that in release notes/changelog.

ci-bot: CI: all checks passed — unit/integration/e2e ✅ (tests/4321)

sre-oncall: recommend canary: 6h on dedicated pool with synthetic traffic hitting long-context paths. Add alert if tail latency > 2x baseline OR error rate > 0.2%. Also ensure fallback to compatible model variant if we hit the alert.

maria: proposed rollout in PR: gated merge after RFC minor edits + arch ack; deploy to dedicated canary (6h), watch metrics, then global canary. fallback plan included.

aj: can we get arch ack today? if not, what's the earliest release window we can target?

arch-team-bot: RFC review triggered: please ensure PR description has RFC link and a short SLO impact table. Tagging @arch_leads for triage.

maria: updated PR with SLO delta table and small note about determinism. PTAL @aj @leo @arch_leads — thanks

leo: i'll pick this up within ~2h and run the quick perf check on dedicated staging machines. if numbers line up I'll give an arch ok. need a tiny blurb for the console release notes.

aj: adding a pending approval comment on the PR; holding merge until @leo LGTM and arch ack.

maria: thanks everyone — really want this in next week's release if arch is ok. leaving detailed fold in PR for followups :heart:
